q1.q: Do guests need to install an app?
q1.a: No. Guests scan the table QR code with their phone camera and the menu opens in the browser.

q2.a: None beyond what you already own. DineFlow runs on any modern phone, tablet, laptop or TV browser.

q3.q: How long is the free trial?
q3.a: New restaurants get a free trial (14 days by default) with full access. No credit card is required to start.

q4.q: Can I use my own currency and taxes?
q4.a: Yes. Each restaurant sets its own currency, timezone, tax rate and service charge.

q5.a: Yes. Every restaurant's data is strictly isolated, and staff only see what their role allows.

q6.a: The interface is available in English, বাংলা and हिन्दी, with more languages planned.
